text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.2 solar radii and 1.03 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,847 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: HD 117618
quotes.card: HD 117618, named Dofida by the IAU, is a single, yellow-hued star in the southern constellation of Centaurus.
quotes.introduction: With an apparent visual magnitude of 7.17, it is too faint to be visible to the naked eyes of a typical observer.
